title: HMAC validation of metadata proxy request conditionally skipped when shared secret is unconfigured
detail: In _handle_instance_id_request_from_lb (lines 265-296), the HMAC signature check that authenticates the metadata proxy is guarded by 'if CONF.neutron.metadata_proxy_shared_secret:' (line 277). When the shared secret is not configured, the block at lines 278-280 is skipped entirely, meaning X-Metadata-Provider and X-Forwarded-For headers are accepted without authentication. An entity that can reach the metadata endpoint and craft these headers could supply an arbitrary provider_id and instance_address to retrieve metadata for any instance whose IP appears in that provider's Neutron networks. The constructor (lines 53-57) logs a WARNING when the secret is absent, but does not reject requests. HMAC validation itself is correctly implemented with hmac.compare_digest when the secret IS present (line 305).
